result.title: Parameter misspecification in physics-informed neural networks: A closed-form audit and its limits
result.comment: 10 pages main body, 3 figures main body, 7 pages supplementary material
result.summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) are trained to minimize the residual of a prescribed equation, so a low training loss does not indicate whether a coefficient in that equation was specified incorrectly. This study evaluates what can be inferred about the encoded parameter from the trained network alone. When the residual is linear in the parameter, written as $A - νB$, the least-squares estimate $\hatν = A^{\top}B/B^{\top}B$ is obtained from a single evaluation of the frozen network, without retraining or reference data. Its accuracy depends on how closely the network satisfies its own equation, quantified by a normalized residual $ρ$. Recovery error is associated with $ρ$ (log-log correlation 0.72 across 36 convection-diffusion networks), and empirical exponents of 0.63 to 1.20 across three equations decompose into one half plus a measurable angular term. For Burgers' equation, a single-model test based on a block-bootstrap standard error flagged 3 of 300 correctly specified networks (observed false-alarm rate 1%), all 2% misspecifications at a practical budget, and two thirds of 1% misspecifications after convergence. For the self-similar blowup rate of the Córdoba-Córdoba-Fontelos equation, where the rate also enters the architecture, the estimator recovers about half of the misspecification, whereas $ρ$ increases approximately quadratically and distinguishes a 0.2% error. When the incorrect rate enters both the equation and the architecture, errors of up to 2% were not detected at the precision reached. At practical budgets, the raw loss can be lower for the misspecified model, a scaling effect that $ρ$ does not share.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究 PINN 中方程系数被错误指定时，仅凭训练后的网络能推断出多少该参数：在残差对参数线性（A-νB）时给出闭式最小二乘估计，不需重训或参考数据，并引入归一化残差 ρ 刻画网络满足自身方程的程度，在多个方程上统计恢复误差与错设检测率。
AI.relevance_reason: 对冻结网络做单次评估即可闭式读出内部编码参数、并用 ρ 作为内部一致性的可靠性指标，可能为核查 latent 状态是否保留任务必要信息、以及为错设/失败检测提供可借鉴的探针思路，需进一步核查其能否迁移到 VLM 推理诊断。
